name: rf
description: RingFrame: turn one explicit intent into a confirmed native prompt, evaluate the exact result, record the decision

interface.shortDescription: Explicit Ask, Eval, and Seal inside Codex
interface.longDescription: Ask compiles one intent into a confirmed prompt for a native Codex capability and hands it to you to submit. Eval checks an exact result against it. Seal records the decision. Requires the ringframe CLI (uv tool install ringframe) and a native request_user_input confirmation tool in the current session.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $rf:ask to turn an intent into a confirmed Codex prompt.
